scope_note: This inventory contains scientifically eligible or conditionally eligible PINN type/variant candidates carried forward from Task 4.1B. It is not a canonical taxonomy and does not create pinn_type_id or parent/child placement.
excluded_note: The 59 other Task-4.1B-selected forms remain in the Abbreviation Registry Candidate Inventory because they currently represent adjacent/non-type concepts such as operator-learning, broader PIML, software, or negative labels rather than candidates for direct PINN type taxonomy placement.
collision_rule: Applicable Task 4.1C collision IDs C001-C030 are retained on candidate rows; no collision is silently normalized away.
evidence_locator_status: Evidence IDs and exact source locators are included only when already available from prior verified work; Task 4.1D does not invent missing locators.
evidence_driven_revision_rule: Later primary-source evidence may revise meaning, classification, alias/collision interpretation, family/variant placement, or eligibility. Any revision must be explicit, evidence-backed, versioned and historically traceable; raw wording and prior decisions remain preserved.
canonicalization_rule: Candidate membership is not canonical taxonomy membership. Final classification remains Task 4.2.
